0.EN:
This appears to be another retro game shop.
Electric Street really has a lot of niche shops right next to each other.

1.EN:
This is the PC Engine, and that machine is an old gaming computer.
There were many games developed for gaming computers back then.

2.EN:
It had more storage than video game consoles at the time,
so games for it could have detailed animations and voice lines.

3.EN:
Castle Rondo was originally made for the PC Engine,
and there was a cyberpunk adventure game called Swatcher
that practically looked like a movie with how detailed it was...

4.EN: "Wow, that sounds really cool! Now I want to play it."

5.EN:
Yesss, this is what I wanted to see!
A giant stack of game cartridges!

6.EN:
I want somethin' we can play together,
like "Waterfall City Heist", but nothin' too rowdy.

7.EN:
We could take turns playin' somethin' like "Super Morioh",
but that's not co-op... Huh, it's harder to pick a game than I thought.

8.EN: Do you know any retro games with two-player co-op, Manager?

10.EN:
That sounds pretty easy to pick up 'n' play!
The characters are cute too! Good taste, manager!

11.EN:
Hey, why don't we play for a bit here?
They said we can play with any of the cartridges!

12.EN:
I've never really had the chance to play
video games with anyone else, so... C'mon!

13.EN: Welcome... Oh, Lady Favna! How are you on this fine day?

15.EN:
It's been a while, Guardian of the Abundant Fields.
I am glad to see your soul is as bright as ever.

16.EN:
Oh, you flatter me, Lady Favna!
Your divine aura has become even more stunning!

17.EN:
(This guy seems to have a lot of experience with
Favna-speak. I'll leave them to it...)

18.EN: ...Well then, could I ask you to wait for our next gospel?

19.EN: Yes, of course! Have a safe trip back!

20.EN:
We shall visit another place that presides over ancient holy artifacts—
the Hall of Electronic Game Investigators.

22.EN:
There's a hidden bar in the arcade,
but you need a password and specific items to go inside.

23.EN:
Once you've gotten all of the items,
come back to Super Potato!

25.EN: The Sun Hard Drive, Raincloud Joystick, and Dragon Badge!

26.EN: To think someone would finally collect all three...!

29.EN:
To commemorate your passion for video games,
I'll entrust you with this!
